channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jared McCain | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jared McCain from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Jared McCain
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Jared McCain’s popularity:

“I can't speak for the masses. I certainly can't speak for young fans. I’m 41. But he's so likable... He got a little bump in practice the other day, and I asked him how he was doing. He's like, ‘It's amazing.’”

Mark Daigneault on Jared McCain, Oct 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain
item.description:
Chet Holmgren on his offseason workouts and runs with Jared McCain:

“There's not much incentive to involve each other on those runs if you don't actually play in the season with the guys you're out there with. When it was me and Jared, we didn't really care who was our team. We would just play 2-man games.”

Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain, Sep 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Sam Presti on Jared McCain
item.description:
Justin Martinez:Sam Presti on what he saw in Jared McCain:

“I've followed Jared since he was in high school and have always thought very highly of him. Just his makeup and his approach and his game, I've always felt like he's a guy who contributes to winning.... He had the right mindset to walk into a team like ours. ... I'm looking forward to a full summer with him, a full training camp with him, and really seeing how he accents our full team.”

Sam Presti on Jared McCain, Jun 8, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Jared McCain
item.description:
Andre Drummond:

“I am very happy for Jared McCain. I wish we kept him,obviously, but I think he went to a good situation, a team that is going to help him develop and help him grow. I love the kid to death. Very, very good kid.”

Andre Drummond on Jared McCain, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain
item.description:
Chet Holmgren on his first impressions of Jared McCain:

“I watched a little bit of his Linsanity run last year before he unfortunately got hurt. I knew he could do more than just shoot.”

Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain, May 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ajay Mitchell on Jared McCain
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Ajay Mitchell on Jared McCain:

“He’s a crazy shooter. He’s a crazy scorer. It’s amazing to have him on the team.. Having him on the court is huge for us.”

Ajay Mitchell on Jared McCain, May 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain:

“Every time I see him get a touch, I think it's going in. I *know* it's going up...”

Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain, May 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Jared McCain
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Jared McCain being aggressive with his shot:

“Seems it to me. I haven’t known him that long. But he keeps chucking them up there.”

Mark Daigneault on Jared McCain, May 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Daryl Morey, Jared McCain
item.description:
OKC Thunder head coach Mark Daigneault on the Jared McCain trade:

“I'm not involved in the trades. So I'm not going to make comments on the acquisitions. I do know I have high respect for Philadelphia, their decision-making process, their group. I know that transactions are to be evaluated in a sequence. They aren't to be evaluated in a vacuum. They are set up by previous transactions, they set up future transactions. It's hard to evaluate those things in a vacuum. You never know what a team is planning and how that fits in. That's why our group, Sam and his guys and Daryl Morey and his guys do their due diligence and work the league around the deadline. That's why all this happens. But I do have great respect for their front office.”

Mark Daigneault on Daryl Morey, Jared McCain, Mar 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain:

“He's been great since he's been here... He was big for us tonight. We're happy to have him.”

Chet Holmgren on Jared McCain, Feb 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jared McCain
item.description:
SGA on Jared McCain:

“He was great tonight. There was a spurt in the game where he kept us afloat, scoring wise. Great shooting touch. He's going to continue get better the more he's in our system. Kid's really talented at basketball.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Jared McCain, Feb 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Jared McCain
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“I'm quite confident that we were selling high [on Jared McCain]. Obviously, only time will tell.”

Daryl Morey on Jared McCain, Feb 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Jared McCain
item.description:
“That's why we did [the McCain] deal a little early -- we were trying to reuse those draft picks to add now. We do feel like this deal sets us up better in the future, but we were looking to add now, and nothing materialized.”

Daryl Morey on Jared McCain, Feb 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey, Jared McCain
item.description:
Nick Nurse on the Clippers’ defense vs Tyrese Maxey and Jared McCain:

“They sent a lot of people at ‘em. They had the lane plugged pretty good, kinda random. They were playing a 2-on-2, switching a lot and then just kinda had a rover in the middle, almost like a spy…”

Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey, Jared McCain, Nov 25, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on Jared McCain
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Maxey, on McCain's growing role on the team:

“I was ecstatic that we found somebody that can give me relief, and a break, so I don't have to have the ball in my hand so much... Sowe have another guy out there who can make players, can shoot the ball, can play off the ball, on the ball, it just makes the game a lot easier.”

Tyrese Maxey on Jared McCain, Nov 23, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Jared McCain
item.description:
Daryl Morey on the addition of Jared McCain:

“We really value shooting given the rest of the roster. Especially, Joel. We just think Joel’s unguardable when he has shooting around him.”

Daryl Morey on Jared McCain, Jun 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @Ky_Carlin.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Jared McCain
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“We were looking at a lot of scenarios with trade out, trade back, and that all went away when Jared [McCain] was there.”

Daryl Morey on Jared McCain, Jun 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.
